definitions.cohort: 2022/2023 REG unless overridden; live pass/run excluding kneels, spikes, no_play and all special teams. Physical outcomes exclude accepted penalties.
definitions.dropback: qb_dropback or pass_attempt: sacks and scrambles included; designed rush excludes scrambles.
definitions.throw: Recorded complete/incomplete/interception outcome; sacks excluded even though pass_attempt includes them.
definitions.success: 40/60/100% of yards to go; positiveEPA separately uses nflfastR's model.
definitions.ranges: Equal-weight observed team-season means, p10/p50/p90. Descriptive variation, not confidence intervals or mandatory acceptance bands.
definitions.context: Offense-relative preplay score; observational cells, no causal claim about risk or pressure. Sparse flag below 40 calling plays; inspect every metric's denominator.

ftnCharting.attribution: FTN Data via nflverse; charting and derived charting aggregates: CC-BY-SA-4.0
ftnCharting.note: Charting labels overlap. Catchability/interception-worthiness are judgments; QB hit is not all pressure, and no label establishes the cause of an inaccurate throw.

rosterBenchmarks.note: Season roster snapshot joined to actual REG participation by exact PFR ID. Preserve measured height/mass pairs when sampling. Broad OL/DL/LB/DB labels do not identify every on-field role. Historical combine drills are not current capacity, technique, cognition or quality ratings; missing drills stay missing.
